notes.title: Skelattack February Dev Update!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/5a45ba331a9d0ff8675ba76ec788bdbf0442c55e.gif

Good morning and happy #screenshotsaturday to all of our dungeon crew! Things are looking up in the dungeon and the Ukuza team has been hard at work expanding the dungeon and adding some amazing things to the game. Lets dive right in to the Skelattack February Dev Update!

As you see above, we've been reworking a TON of animations in the game. The goal was to bring more fluidity to the characters, give them more life, and allow them new mechanics. All of the assets in this game are hand-drawn and digitally inked as vector graphics giving them a super clean look. You can see in the gif above, Skully has new idle, jumping, wall sliding, respawn, and attack animations. There are also many new ones not shown here that add new abilities to gameplay and give players much more choice on how they play the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/00fa8d429dd079f6d4c364260962f144d9fce126.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/041dac112e9d4f85c54ccc163d021c0d284620fe.gif

Imber also received new animation updates! Our flappy and friendly sidekick has multiple new animations. We've redone her idle to give her more character and also improved her animation when carrying Skully's bag-o-bones through the air.  You'll also see above that there is a brand new, never before seen animation of her doing a corkscrew attack. What could this possibly mean for Imber and her gameplay?! (☉_☉) You guessed it! More gameplay with Imber standalone and as a means of offense for Skully!

https://media.giphy.com/media/MAknCrFQHcykg/giphy.gif

We know! Exciting right?! We have lots of secrets in store around new game mechanics, hazards, and story. Speaking of the story, we've been hard at work expanding on the story and weaving narrative throughout the entire gameplay experience. Themes of friendship, love, life & death, and our hero's backstory are now woven throughout the game and the choices players make. Don't worry, we didn't get totally sappy with it! The entire thing is still wrapped up in the Tim Burton-esque quirkiness of the world and characters with funny dialogue and storylines.

We have been working on building out two brand new areas of the dungeon that include the Lava Forge where dungeon dwellers forge blades and other materials, and the Crypt which holds the back story of our dungeon dwellers. This also includes new bosses with new hazards, puzzles, and mechanics. In addition to that, we've been expanding on existing levels with new areas and brand new tile assets. Two of those areas have been The Greenery and The Prison.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/f623e834a6771d31cbeecf73cb08717e6e8c32b7.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/6ce6f94edd57c2bd2783c387dc83ee030bc391d3.png

We have tons more coming your way! New characters, new side quests, new gameplay mechanics, new hazards, and more! We can't wait to show you more of the new things in store.

If you haven't already, be sure to add Skelattack to your Steam Wishlist! Also, follow-us on Twitter for daily updates, and join our Discord to chat with other members of the dungeon crew!

Cheers and see you in the dungeon!

notes.title: Skelattack November Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/d8042272f6b8dc3cf348296623f2fb3ea1ef9bdd.jpg

Hello, dungeon crew!

Welcome to November's Skelattack update. If you don't follow us on Twitter or are part of our Skelattack Discord, be sure to follow-us as we've had many updates happening on the game. We have held a few Developers Den streams on Mixer showcasing lots of new items for the game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/04ca34e000418e25048f4febffd00c77b47ec9f1.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/8b5c8a5f87f0692d064237bc114737200dffb2f9.jpg

Our team has been hard at work adding more to the game. Just this past month, we released our brand new demo that includes updated art assets, enhanced character controls, enemy knight parry system, and a lot more. That demo was released on Skelattack.com, Gamejolt, and IndieDB. We just recently also released the demo on Steam so you can enjoy the demo right alongside your collection of other games. So be sure to download the demo from the Steam store page!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/44bd7e61f8706a09c4a2c0b399b21b4e6796bdd7.jpg

If you haven't played the new demo yet, bosses have gotten more difficult. Multistage boss battles have been implemented. You now have to switch up ways to defeat the bosses with new attacks at various stages of the fight. Bosses also now have the ability to block your magic of respawning at a blue torch. You have limited respawns during the boss fights when your immortality torches are blocked. If you die too many times, you are sent to see the Shepherd of the Damned where you can choose to jump back in the fight at a spawn point before the boss or quit the game and jump back out to the dungeon hub.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/30561b550be4218ca53a761fe0467885ebf4048f.jpg

Knights no longer just take your hits. We've implemented a parry system where they will block your attacks and will attack after. The knights have upped their game! Acid pools are now scattered throughout the dungeon that will singe your bones!

Another exciting thing we've been working on are two new levels: The Crypt and the Lava Forge where things heat up! These will add two brand new bosses to the game that will include new attacks and challenges.  The Crypt is the underground area where the dead are stored. It sounds like a party when they are your undead neighbor! The Lava Forge will test your platforming skills as you avoid burning up in the molten earth.

On the business end, our team has been in discussions for partnerships that will expand the reach of our reverse dungeon crawler. This will include new markets, larger marketing, and more. Stay tuned!

We are working hard to add many exciting things to the game. Where we started with Skelattack versus where we are now are completely different. The gameplay mechanics, the story, the characters, and the levels have all been expanding. We can't wait to show you more of the new areas and some of the reworked assets we've been designing.

So download the new demo on Steam, follow us on Twitter and Discord, and stay up-to-date on the latest Skelattack happenings!

notes.title: PAX Feedback and Release Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30369838/bd975bf0fa1353c8e90b9c5e568049cf97f1fbe7.jpg

The team has just come back from an awesome weekend exhibiting at PAX South and wow, the feedback was amazing! We can't say how grateful we are for the overwhelmingly positive response from our fans, distributors, and others within the gaming community.

Our team is working through certification right now for a few of our different distribution platforms. That combined with some of the amazing feedback we received from fans, we have moved the release date back on Skelattack. This will allow us to make a few critical updates we see as being integral to what our fans would like to see.

Normally certification can take up to 8 weeks. We are now targeting March for Skelattack's release on PC, Mac, Linux, and Xbox. Stick around for some very cool dev updates and new opportunities that are in play for Skully, Imber, and all of their dungeon neighbors. Thanks again for all of the amazing support and we can't wait to show you more!
